seo.title: SplitEasy — Good accounts make good friends
seo.description: Log your group's expenses in seconds. SplitEasy works out who owes what, and tells you how to settle up with the fewest possible transfers.

problem.title: Who paid for the gas, again?
problem.text: Receipts pile up in your pockets, the math happens on a napkin, and there's always that slightly awkward message: "uh… you still owe me for the weekend, right?". The result: nobody really knows who owes what anymore.
problem.bubble1: Did I pay you back for dinner or not?
problem.bubble2: Wait, who bought the groceries again?
problem.bubble3: Should we just split it evenly?
problem.bubbleFinal: I put it all on SplitEasy

steps.title: How it works
steps.step1Text: Trip, flat share, birthday… invite your friends with a simple link.
steps.step2Text: Who paid, for whom. Equal shares, exact amounts or percentages.
steps.step3Text: SplitEasy tells you exactly who pays back whom.

settle.title: 6 transfers? Try 2.
settle.text: When everyone owes everyone, SplitEasy simplifies the debts so each person makes as few transfers as possible.
settle.imageAlt: Six crossed reimbursements simplified into two transfers

split.title: Everyone pays their exact share, down to the cent.
split.text: Equal shares, exact amounts, weighted shares or percentages: leftover cents are always distributed automatically, never lost.
split.imageAlt: A bill automatically split between three friends

currency.title: Pick your group's currency.
currency.text: Euro, US dollar, Tunisian dinar, pound sterling, Moroccan dirham or Swiss franc: each group has its own currency, shown everywhere it matters.
currency.imageAlt: A travel suitcase surrounded by euro, dollar and dinar coins
currency.conversionNote: Someone paid in another currency? SplitEasy converts it automatically at the day's rate.

budgetGoals.title: Set a budget, save toward a goal.
budgetGoals.text: Cap your spending by category or for the whole group, and track a shared pot for your next trip, gift or event. SplitEasy alerts you the moment a budget is blown.

secondary.splitTypes: Equal shares, amounts, weighted shares or percentages
secondary.inviteLink: Join a group with a single link
secondary.filters: Expenses filterable by category and participant
secondary.editDelete: Expenses can be edited and deleted

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes. SplitEasy is free, with no limit on the number of groups or expenses.
faq.q2: Do my friends need to create an account?
faq.a2: No. You can add a participant without an account (like "Grandma"); only the person who wants to check their expenses online needs to sign up.
faq.a3: Your data is protected by secure authentication and is only accessible to members of the relevant group.
faq.q4: Does it work with several currencies?
faq.a4: Each group has a single currency, chosen when it's created, among EUR, USD, TND, GBP, MAD and CHF.
faq.q5: Does SplitEasy make the transfers for me?
faq.a5: No. SplitEasy works out who owes what and shows you the transfers to make; you make them yourself, then mark them as settled in the app.

finalCta.title: Your next weekend deserves better than a spreadsheet.
finalCta.reassurance: Free. Your friends don't even need an account.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.p1Text: Your name, email address, and the expenses/groups you create. That's it: no ad tracking, no reselling to third parties.
privacy.p2Text: Only the members of a group can see that group's expenses. No one else has access.
privacy.p3Text: Your login token and theme preference (light/dark) are stored locally on your device, never shared.
privacy.p4Text: You can delete a group at any time from its settings. To delete your account entirely, contact us.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.p1Text: SplitEasy works out who owes what and suggests settlements. The app never makes real transfers: you make the payments yourself, then mark them as settled.
terms.p2Text: SplitEasy is free, with no limit on groups or expenses, provided "as is" without a guarantee of continuous availability.
terms.p3Text: You're responsible for the accuracy of amounts entered and for any repayments made outside the app.
terms.p4Text: You can stop using SplitEasy at any time. Deleting a group permanently deletes its expenses.
